name: John
summary: The son of Zacharias and Elisabeth, sent by God to prepare the way for Jesus. He preached repentance, baptized people in the Jordan, and pointed others to Jesus as the Lamb of God.

key_moments.title: Named John
key_moments.description: Elisabeth gave birth to a son in her old age. Neighbours wanted to name him after his father, but she said he would be called John, and Zacharias wrote the same.

key_moments.title: A Voice in the Wilderness
key_moments.description: John preached in the wilderness of Judaea, telling people to repent because heaven's kingdom was near. He wore camel's hair, ate locusts and honey from the wild, and baptized people in the Jordan.

key_moments.title: Baptizing Jesus
key_moments.description: Jesus came to be baptized, and John said he needed to be baptized by Jesus instead. When Jesus came up from the water, the Spirit came down like a dove and a voice from heaven spoke.

key_moments.title: The Lamb of God
key_moments.description: Seeing Jesus coming toward him, John called Him the Lamb of God who takes away the world's sin. The next day two of John's disciples heard him and followed Jesus.

key_moments.title: Beheaded by Herod
key_moments.description: John told Herod it was not lawful for him to have his brother's wife, so Herod put him in prison. At Herod's birthday feast, the daughter of Herodias asked for John's head, and Herod had him beheaded.
